what: The header logo folds when scrolled down. Once the document is scrolled past 400px, the fold timeline runs to the end over 1s cubic-bezier(.2,.1,0,1), and on return to the top it unfolds along the same path. Progress merges the scroll value g and the state value s (menu · search open, sub-page) as 1 − (1 − g)(1 − s), so opening the menu while it is unfolding does not unfold it again. Timeline: the upper table pieces fold −90° about the top left and the lower pieces fold 90° about the bottom left and vanish (1.2s power1.inOut, .22s gap). From .18s the slogan letters slide 91px left while blurring (1s power2.inOut, .009s gap), from .2s the wordmark letters are pushed along too, and from .38s the logo frame width shrinks to .578x and the text group to .83x (1s power1.inOut). The pieces fold out of the table box and are clipped. Sub-pages start already folded (folded)

options.shift: Distance letters travel when leaving (px), default 91.34 (phone original 51.6)
options.narrow: Folded frame width / initial width, default .578 (301 → 174)
options.scale: Folded text chunk size, default .83 (phone original .988)
options.lift: Distance risen while folding (px) — original phone 17.5
options.height: Collapsed frame height (px) — if given, it shrinks from .4s to .9s (original phone 100 → 55)
options.state-dur / state-ease: Length and curve when folding and unfolding with fx:fold · fx:unfold, default dur · ease (original menu·search .8 · power1.inOut)
options.folded: If true, starts with the state value s set to 1 (subpages) — on receiving fx:unfold it goes to 0 and follows the scroll again
options.[data-fx-part=mark]: Table box — folded pieces are clipped and hidden
options.[data-fx-part=lockup]: The group to shrink (if none, body, and if that is missing, the wordmark) — shrinks around the top left so the folded text sticks to the left end of the logo
options.[data-fx-part=body]: Inner panel raised by lift (the element itself if none)
options.[data-fx-part=top] / [data-fx-part=botto: Top and bottom pieces of the table — fold away and vanish
options.fx:fold / fx:unfold: State value s as 1 / 0 (state-dur·state-ease) — when opening and closing the menu or search, and when turning pages
